name: Sporeborn Sheep AP OLD

generalAbilities.name: Headless
generalAbilities.description: A headless spore sheep can't make Jaws attacks.

generalAbilities.name: Slow
generalAbilities.description: A zombie is permanently Slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wasting Wheeze
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per 1d4 #recharge wasting wheeze rounds

Trigger The headless spore sheep takes a critical hit or is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The headless spore sheep exhales a cloud of spores through its neck. Adjacent living creatures take 1d6 Poison Damage damage and are Sickened 1 unless they succeed at a DC 18 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Zombie Rot
offensiveAbilities.description:
An infected creature can't heal damage it takes from zombie rot until it has been cured of the disease.

Saving Throw DC 18 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 1d6 Void Damage damage (1 day)

Stage 3 1d6 Void Damage damage (1 day)

Stage 4 1d6 Void Damage damage (1 day)

Stage 5 dead, rising as a plague zombie immediately

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

recallKnowledge: Arcana or Nature or Nature or Religion, DC 15
